monitor_ip.description: The IP address on which the monitor daemon binds/listens.

monitor_pid_path.description: Path to the PID file for the monitor daemon.

monitor_bin_path.description: Path to the mysql-mmm binary directory.

monitor_status_path.description: Path to the monitor status file.

monitor_ping_ips.description: Space-separated list of IPs to ping for health checks.

monitor_auto_set_online.description: Number of successful pings before marking a host as online.

monitor_user.description: MySQL user used by the monitor for checking replication status.

monitor_password.description: Password for the MySQL monitor user.
